subject.title: fix(mattermost): preserve text-block boundaries in draft preview (#87322)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Mattermost behavior where block-mode draft preview and preview-off block streaming produce separate visible posts, plus the optional `DraftStreamLoop.takePending` exported type?
rationale: The code path appears correct, but the PR deliberately changes user-visible delivery shape and expands an exported channel contract, which are maintainer product/API decisions rather than automated repair choices.

options.title: Accept current shape
options.body: Approve the multiple-post Mattermost behavior for the affected non-default modes and accept the optional draft-loop API as the narrow support seam.

options.title: Require live UI proof first
options.body: Keep the implementation direction but ask for a self-hosted Mattermost UI or server transcript before accepting the delivery-shape change.

options.title: Narrow or rework API
options.body: Ask the contributor to preserve the behavior fix while avoiding the exported draft-loop type addition or reducing the visible delivery-shape change.

recommendation.title: Accept current shape
recommendation.body: Approve the multiple-post Mattermost behavior for the affected non-default modes and accept the optional draft-loop API as the narrow support seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent member-review signal on this branch and appear in recent Mattermost-area history for the touched path.
